meta.title: Firefox Browser Control
meta.description: Drives your own Firefox: a switch in the toolbar grants access, controlled tabs get a red outline and a green tab marker, and a WebDriver BiDi path remains as fallback.

tools.firefox_status: Check how DSH can reach Firefox
tools.firefox_open: Open a tab in your Firefox that DSH controls
tools.firefox_eval: Read state out of a Firefox tab
tools.firefox_navigate: Open a URL in a Firefox tab
tools.firefox_input: Click, type or press keys in a Firefox tab
tools.firefox_screenshot: Capture a Firefox tab as a PNG
tools.firefox_launch: Start a separate Firefox with the BiDi agent (fallback)
